title: Driver Vehicle Inspection Log Form
subtitle: Driver Vehicle Inspection: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Driver Vehicle Inspection Log Form covers power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status. The fleet dispatch coordinator records Driver Vehicle Inspection events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Driver Vehicle Inspection Log Form keeps Driver Vehicle Inspection exceptions visible until the fleet dispatch coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Driver Vehicle Inspection Log Form at yard, roadside safe area, vehicle cab, exterior walkaround, and trailer. Document power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status identity before Driver Vehicle Inspection begins. Compare power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status findings with stated Driver Vehicle Inspection criteria; route unresolved Driver Vehicle Inspection issues to qualified vehicle maintenance reviewer. For Driver Vehicle Inspection Log Form, confirm requirements for Driver Vehicle Inspection. Ask qualified vehicle maintenance reviewer to review Driver Vehicle Inspection conditions beyond the fleet dispatch coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking variance reference and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Driver Vehicle Inspection, identify responsible parties, yard, roadside safe area, vehicle cab, exterior walkaround, and trailer, and the linked power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status source.

fields.label: Vehicle, unit, plate, odometer, and trailer
Prior defect, repair, and release references

sections.title: Status events and next-control history
sections.guidance: Capture Driver Vehicle Inspection facts for power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Driver Vehicle Inspection tracked controls
items: Tires, wheels, fasteners, and visible inflation
Lights, reflectors, mirrors, glazing, and wipers
Brakes, steering, suspension, coupling, and visible leaks
Horn, warning devices, emergency equipment, and restraints
Load securement, doors, landing gear, and trailer condition
Defect classification, restriction, repair, and release

sections.title: Current status outcome and next update
sections.guidance: Keep the Driver Vehicle Inspection chronology intact through handoff. State the unresolved exception, the owner selected by Fleet Dispatch Coordinator, and the next control point.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Driver Vehicle Inspection when a safety-critical defect, inspection limitation, repair verification, or qualified release remains unresolved. Retain the available Driver Vehicle Inspection proof and route unresolved power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status scope to fleet dispatch coordinator.
